query: What is the standard return window?
golden_answer: Customers may request a standard return within 30 days of delivery. Items should be unused and returned with the original packaging when possible.

query: How long do refunds normally take after an approved return reaches the warehouse?
golden_answer: Refunds are normally processed within 5 to 7 business days after the approved return reaches the warehouse. Bank processing time may add delay.

query: How long does standard shipping take after dispatch?
golden_answer: Standard shipping normally takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.
